name: Ukin Bunsoku
source:
A member of Gi's City guard along with [url=/c25771]Maou[/url] and [url=/c25775]Nagi[/url] and [url=/c63854]Kazuto's[/url] subordinate. Sawa doesn't really like wars or fighting, but she's a very gentle girl who is working hard to bring peace to the land.

She likes fashion and sweets and skips on her patrol duties a lot to got to sweets and clothing shops. She had no idea how to command soldiers until Kazuto taught her the "American" way.
